language.name: English
error.nothing_found: Found no video or photos at this link.
error.geo_blocked: This video isn't available in your country.
error.sign_in: {site} only shows this to people who are signed in.
error.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted, so {site} only shows it to people who are signed in.
error.members_only: This video is only for the channel's members.
error.bot_check: {site} wants to check you're not a bot before showing this.
error.rate_limited: {site} has had too many requests from you for now. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.unavailable: This video isn't available any more. It may have been removed or taken down.
error.not_found: There's nothing at this address (404). Check the link.
error.not_started: This live stream or premiere hasn't started yet. Try again once it's on.
error.drm: This video is copy-protected (DRM), so it can't be saved.
error.format_unavailable: The quality chosen in Settings isn't available for this video. Choose "Best" and try again.
error.network: Couldn't reach {site}. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.timeout: {site} took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
error.disk_full: Your disk is full. Make some space, then retry.
error.needs_ffmpeg: This needs ffmpeg, which Whydah couldn't get. Run a refit, or install ffmpeg.
error.page_timeout: The page took too long to load.
error.page_open: The hidden browser couldn't open the page.
error.playlist_empty: This playlist is empty, or none of its items can be downloaded.
error.linked_none: None of the linked pages had a video Whydah could get.
error.cookies_blocked: macOS is blocking access to {browser}'s cookies.
error.signin_no_browser: Signing in needs Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Chromium or Vivaldi installed.
error.signin_open: The sign-in window is open. Close it when you're done signing in, then try again.
error.signin_busy: Whydah is using the sign-in browser for a look. Try again when it's done.
error.output_folder: Can't save to the download folder {path}.
error.photos_partial.one: Saved {count} photo, but some couldn't be saved.
error.photos_partial.other: Saved {count} photos, but some couldn't be saved.
error.gallery_dl_missing: gallery-dl isn't available. Run a refit to get it.
error.name_token: File names can't use {token}. They can use {tokens}.
error.name_unique: File names need {title} or {id} in them, or every download would get the same name.
error.name_path: File names must stay inside the download folder: no "..", and don't start with "/" or "~".
hint.cookies_off: If you can see it in your browser, turn on Settings → Cookies from browser, then try again.
hint.cookies_on: Make sure you're signed in to {site} in {browser}, then try again.
hint.cookies_blocked: Give {launcher} Full Disk Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access), then quit and reopen it. Or turn off cookies in Settings.
hint.cookies_blocked_unknown: Give the app you started Whydah from Full Disk Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access), then quit and reopen it. Or turn off cookies in Settings.
hint.forbidden: A refit often fixes this. If you can see it in your browser, turn on Settings → Cookies from browser.
hint.forbidden_cookies: A refit often fixes this. Or sign in to {site} again in {browser}.
hint.cookies_own: Sign in to {site} in Whydah's sign-in browser, then try again.
hint.forbidden_own: A refit often fixes this. Or sign in to {site} again in Whydah's sign-in browser.
ui.names_example: Use {tokens}; a / makes folders. Playlists and galleries keep their own folders. For example:
ui.bookmarklet_hint: Drag it to your browser's bookmarks bar. Clicking it on any page opens that page here.
ui.signout_confirm: Sign out of every site in Whydah's sign-in browser? This deletes its profile.
ui.signin_hint: For sites that don't keep you signed in with your browser's cookies. Opens a {browser} window with a profile of Whydah's own: sign in to the sites you need, then close the window.
ui.signin_open: The sign-in window is open. Close it when you're done.
ui.signin_waiting: Waiting for you to close the sign-in window…
ui.history_clear_confirm: Clear the whole history? Your files stay where they are.
